headline: FTC launches formal investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic over AI product risks
body: The Federal Trade Commission has opened a formal investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI companies, examining product risks and business practices. For healthcare AI deployments, this signals regulatory scrutiny is intensifying around safety, transparency, and liability in clinical applications. Organizations implementing large language models in EHR systems, clinical decision support, or patient-facing tools should expect heightened compliance requirements and potential restrictions on data handling practices. Healthcare vendors and consulting firms advising on AI adoption need to factor regulatory uncertainty into implementation timelines and ensure documentation of safety testing protocols aligns with FTC expectations.
